tree_state: all listed files are committed at the recorded commit
summary: tools/ios/ipsw_inspect.py: an offline, read-only IPSW inspector (zipfile + plistlib + a DER reader + the pure-Python LZFSE decoder tools/ios/lzfse_py.py, a port of lzfse/lzfse e634ca58). Five verdicts (accepted, wrong-build, wrong-device, missing-member, not-an-ipsw) with the offending item named; zip-slip and unsafe manifest paths refused; streaming SHA-256 (CRC-checked reads); kernelcache IM4P parse and Darwin banner without decoding the whole image; the report always says compatibility not-assessed. Nothing is extracted. 53 inspector tests on synthetic archives and 14 decoder tests on encoder-made vectors; 25 hand-chosen inspector mutants all killed (one survivor found and fixed on the way).
evidence_category: host-test. Synthetic archives carry only the minimal manifest keys; no Apple data is invented or embedded (the test file says so). The decoder was additionally compared byte for byte with the pinned reference C decoder on the real iPhone10,3 16.5 kernelcache (50,888,732 bytes, equal to the IM4P trailer size); that comparison needs the local Apple file and is not repeatable from the repository. The decoder tests are not mutation-tested; the inspector tests are.

acceptance.1_zipfile_plistlib_no_extraction: inspect() opens the archive with zipfile, parses BuildManifest.plist with plistlib, reports ProductBuildVersion, ProductVersion, SupportedProductTypes, device classes, the paths of OS/Cryptex1,SystemOS/Cryptex1,AppOS, DeviceTree, KernelCache (and restore variants, ramdisk, trust caches); nothing is written to disk (test_unsafe_names_never_reach_the_filesystem); --sha256 hashes members by 1 MiB streaming reads and a corrupted stored member fails the CRC check (test_corrupted_member_data_is_detected_when_hashing).
acceptance.2_verdicts: VERDICTS is exactly the five names (test_verdict_vocabulary_is_exactly_the_five); wrong-build names the found build, wrong-device the supported list or the classes found, missing-member the absent path, not-an-ipsw the unsafe/absent/foreign item; `compatibility` is the constant not-assessed (a mutant that changes it is killed).
acceptance.3_synthetic_tests: tests/test_ipsw_inspect.py: accepted, each rejecting case, zip-slip names (../, nested .., absolute, drive letter, backslash; NUL checked on unsafe_member directly because zipfile itself truncates NULs), unsafe manifest paths, an absent file, a directory, an empty file, a listed-but-absent member, a component with differing per-identity paths (the real D22AP Erase/Update RestoreRamDisk case).
